title: Tess Dislikes a Bath
lines: Our cat Tess dislikes a bath.
She hid under the bed all day.
Sam got the tub and the soap.
Tess hissed. Tess and Sam disagree.
But Sam held up a fish.
Tess came out to get the fish.
Tess likes fish. She still dislikes baths.

questions.listenFor: Under the bed. Quick one - it is in the second line.

questions.ask: What got Tess to come out?
questions.listenFor: The fish Sam held up. Listen for fish, not just Sam.

questions.ask: Do you think Tess got a bath in the end? Why?
questions.listenFor: The story does not say, so both are right. You want the reason.
